annotations.text:
OLD MONEY — EB Garamond.

Ivory ground, EB Garamond for all display (same face web4.ai uses), Jost letterspaced small caps for labels. Display sizes bumped ~9% since Garamond runs smaller and lighter than the Bodoni it replaced.

Grain lifted from record2: 180px feTurbulence tile, soft-light blend, plus a warm vignette. On ivory it reads like paper stock rather than screen noise.

Deep forest = obsession/Cole. Oxblood = casual/Tyler. Brass for hairlines only.

Four boards — say the word and the other eight follow.
